main_body: A tall wooden crate/barrel on the right with a diagonal-plank front and a sack leaning on its right side; a smaller banded barrel stands to the left
top_band: Column x=15: rows 1-2 are a lighter brown (L=98) cap only 2 rows tall, on top of a mid-brown face (L=69) from row 3. No real top surface.
evidence: In the x=15 column the only light band is 2 rows (rows 1-2), a rim or cap line that is too thin to read as a surface. Below it the body is one continuous front face with diagonal planks and a strap at row 9 and rows 10 and 14, painted flat with nothing inset. The small barrel at left has the same problem: a 1-2 row lighter lid and then a straight front with bands, with no ellipse top. Both major parts fail, as in the guide's 'barrel: lid 2px' and 'front elevation' cases.

style.evidence: The outlines are dark brown tinted to the wood, with only 8% of dark edge pixels neutral. Wood shows 4-5 steps (highlight #b77541, #885a26, #6f4725, #633712, #3d220c), and the diagonal plank strokes and strap highlights add texture. Colours per tile (18) match the references (17 and 20) and flat-fill coverage (12%) is close to the stall's 13%. The 24 distinct colours are fewer than the references' 38-40, but the piece is small and single-material. It would sit acceptably next to the references without looking like a sticker.
